title: The Platform Where Fork and Unity Read Each Other

features.name: the dual-reading
features.desc-on-touch: Two things stand apart on the platform, readable from here as equally true. They never converge. They never end their argument. The archive learned it could hold both at once without splitting.

features.name: the reconciled distance
features.desc-on-touch: Empty space that is not empty. The distance between the two paths has become readable as its own fact. You stand in it and understand why contradiction can be true.

features.name: both-true-marker
features.desc-on-touch: A subtle line that does not choose between the left path and the right. It reads both, holds both, lets them contradict forever without resolution. This is the archive's deepest learning.

inscription: both paths are true at once; the archive learned to hold contradiction as fact without collapsing into synthesis

file.name: Convergence_Dual_Argument_Unresolved_Permanent.txt
file.note: Two accounts of the same event that do not reconcile and need not. The archive keeps them both.
